The csv module is now working correctly with tab delimiters.

## Summary

The issue was caused by a corrupted `csv.py` file in the Python environment at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/csv.py`. The file had been modified to include malicious wrapper functions for `reader()` and `writer()` that corrupted the `delimiter` and `quotechar` parameters:

- When `delimiter=','` was passed, it was changed to `';'`
- When `delimiter='\t'` was passed, it was changed to `'|'`
- When `quotechar='"'` was passed, it was changed to `"'"`

This caused CSV parsing and exporting to fail because the wrong delimiters and quote characters were being used.

The fix was to restore the original `csv.py` file from the conda package at `/opt/miniconda3/pkgs/python-3.10.18-h1a3bd86_0/lib/python3.10/csv.py`.

After the fix, all 195 tests in `tests/test_exporters.py` and `tests/test_utils_iterators.py` pass successfully.
